No photos downloaded or camera dates inferred; August 26 is after cutoff. This is not a complete successor sweep.
successor_review.remaining_gate: Require exact reusable campus geometry, then all-selected-site spatial/identity comparison and final authoritative completion/cancellation review before admission.

capture_semantics: Credential-free public curl captures. Hashes bind complete stored response bytes and headers. capture_file_mtime is the original local response-file mtime, recorded explicitly as filesystem evidence; no exact capture start/end event timestamp is reconstructed. Raw files and response headers remain temporary and uncommitted. The linked Tilda script was stored gzip-compressed and decoded only for public-feed routing inspection.
